title: A group says which of its pieces are not following it
goal: A group can now tell its contents how to line up, and any one piece can disagree. There is no way to see the disagreements: you have to click every piece in turn to find out which ones have a rule of their own. The group should say so where the setting is.
notes: From the placement audit 2026-09-03. The data is already there: Layer.placement is non-nil exactly on the pieces that override. PlacementInspector.contentRows is where it goes.
acceptance: With a group selected, the Layout section names the pieces inside it that have their own rule
Clicking one of those names selects that piece
A group where nothing disagrees says nothing extra rather than showing an empty list
